content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD input-reading module: MODULE INPUT_READ (L64-L303), described @L57 as 'a module to handle reading input.txt' (HISTORY 02/17/2016 Fengyan Shi @L60; L12-L55 BSD license header whose FILE line @L14 says 'main.F'). USE PARAM,ONLY:SP @L66; USE GLOBAL,ONLY:myid,ier @L67; USE MPI @L68. Generic INTERFACE READ_FOUR_TYPE_VALUES (L74-L79) dispatches to module procedures READ_FLOAT/READ_STRING/READ_LOGICAL/READ_INTEGER. Each typed reader: INQUIRE existence of InputFileName and MPI_FINALIZE+STOP if missing; CALL READ_VALUE to fetch the value string for MatchCharacter (missing key => warning 'USE DEFAULT VALUE' and RETURN); CALL CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE and on type mismatch MPI_FINALIZE+STOP (READ_INTEGER L107-L111, READ_FLOAT L143-L147, READ_STRING L211-L215) except READ_LOGICAL which only warns (L178-L180) then sets LOGICAL_VAL=.FALSE. and .TRUE. iff first char is 'T' (L182-L183); numeric readers convert via internal READ (L113, L149), READ_STRING uses ADJUSTL(TRIM()) @L217. READ_VALUE (L225-L262) opens unit 10, loops READ(10,'(A)',END=100): strips trailing comment at COM_CHAR '!' via index (L244-L246), locates '=' (L249), compares trimmed LHS to MatchCharacter (L251) and returns the RHS substring ADJUSTL(TEXT(FRONT+1:TEXT_LENGTH)) @L252; on EOF label 100 sets ERR_IF_ONE=1 and CLOSE(10) (L258-L260). CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE (L264-L301) classifies VREAD: length-1 'T'/'F' => 'logical' (L278-L283); any character outside the set numbers="0123456789+-Ee. " => 'string' (L286-L291); contains '.' => 'float', else 'INTEGER' (L294-L299).

calls: intrinsics: TRIM @L94 etc., ADJUSTL @L217/@L251/@L252/@L275, index @L244/@L249/@L294, INDEX @L287, len_trim @L245/@L248, LEN_TRIM @L275, REWIND @L237
unresolved: License header FILE line @L14 says 'main.F' but this file is the INPUT_READ module (mod_input) — header/file-name mismatch

READ_VALUE: successful match RETURNs @L253 without CLOSE(10); CLOSE @L260 is reached only via the EOF path (label 100 @L258) — unit 10 apparently left open on every successful key lookup (relation L237/L253/L260); also each READ_* call re-OPENs unit 10 per key
ERR_IF_ONE has INTENT(OUT) in READ_STRING @L193 and READ_VALUE @L230 but no INTENT attribute in READ_INTEGER @L90, READ_FLOAT @L127, READ_LOGICAL @L162

READ_LOGICAL: type mismatch only warns (L178-L180, no STOP) unlike INTEGER/FLOAT/STRING which MPI_FINALIZE+STOP; value is then set from first character only (L182-L183), so CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE's 'logical' result is not actually required

CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE returns VTYPE 'INTEGER' in uppercase @L298 while other types are lowercase ('float' @L296, 'logical' @L280, 'string' @L288); the comparisons @L107 ('INTEGER'), @L143 ('float'), @L178 ('logical'), @L211 ('string') match these exact cases — case consistency is load-bearing across subroutines
ERR_IF_ONE is initialized to 0 @L236 only inside READ_VALUE; typed readers test ERR_IF_ONE == 1 (L100, L137, L172, L204) relying on READ_VALUE having set it
